method: alembic autogenerate against PostgreSQL 16 at migration head, under the same single-MetaData merge test_autogenerate_is_safe.py performs inside the gate; DropColumnOp operations bucketed by table-name prefix

trust_soft_delete.detail: every trust_* table is physically carrying deleted_at and is_deleted; no trust mapper declares either. One uniform decision, not six.

financial_engine_phase_a.detail: fin_providers (5), fin_transactions (3), fin_subscriptions (2). CLAUDE.md states Phase A is schema-only with routes and services deferred, so unmapped columns here are the documented state rather than drift.
financial_engine_phase_a.disposition: EXPLAINED — no action while ENABLE_FINANCIAL_ENGINE stays off

sndhs_phase_1.detail: patients.national_id, sndhs_health_id, identity_level, consent_flags and lab_orders.visit_id — already pinned by DECLARED_PROTECTED_DROP_COLUMNS. Exposure question answered: no Patient serialisation uses attribute passthrough, so mapping them costs nothing in exposure.
sndhs_phase_1.disposition: DECISION PENDING — map (recommended) or record why not; never drop

singletons.detail: ecosystem_partner_agreements.agreement_version is NR-083's document-version-vs-optimistic-lock question, reaching the same column by a second instrument. oauth2_clients.created_by and service_accounts.api_key_prefix sit on credential tables and deserve individual dispositions.

protected_column_drops.note: counted as lab_id/created_by/updated_by/sync_id/tenant_id/organization_id. NR-082 separately recorded 43 protected radiology columns using a different definition; 52 and 43 are not claimed to confirm each other.

instrument_cross_check: all five entries of the independently maintained DECLARED_PROTECTED_DROP_COLUMNS ledger appear in this proposal and none is missing
